question: DISHA is an initiative under the Ministry of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rural Development**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **DISHA** (District Development Coordination and Monitoring Committee) is an initiative under the **Ministry of Rural Development**.
 
• It **aims to coordinate a**nd ensure the effective implementation of various central government schemes and programs at the district level.
 
• The committees formed under **DISHA include members of Parliament**,
 
 
• elected representatives and government officials to monitor and promote the development activities
 
 
 
• The committee is **chaired by a Member of Parliament (MP) from the district**,
 
 
• ensuring that elected representatives have a direct role in overseeing the development work.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ministry of Rural Development

 
 
• ​It is a key government ministry in India responsible for the formulation and implementation of policies, programs, and schemes aimed at promoting rural development and poverty alleviation.
 
• One of the primary objectives of the ministry is to generate employment in rural areas
 
• Programs like the **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)** aim to provide guaranteed wage employment to rural households, ensuring income security.
 
• Programs like **Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)** aim to provide all-weather roads,
 
 
• while **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)** focuses on providing affordable housing to rural households.
